document: strict UTF-8 LF-only full report, no BOM/NUL/CR, max256KiB
match: all ordered literal bytes and typed slots; exactly one whole-report production; no wildcard prose

OWNER_DISPLAY.syntax: HG-NNN canonical D transformed only by specified case/hyphen spelling
OWNER_DISPLAY.binding: namespaced original owner display identity; never sample ID

ORIGINAL_CHECK_LABEL.syntax: nonempty original check label, max1024 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL/CR/LF
ORIGINAL_CHECK_LABEL.binding: exact ordinal in ordered original report-ref checks

DECLARED_COMMAND.syntax: exact original nonempty command bytes, max4096, no NUL/CR/LF; permitted folded representation only
DECLARED_COMMAND.binding: exact ordinal check command; inert, no expansion/execution

GIT_REVISION_CLAIM.binding: B/T iff annotated; otherwise unverified attribution, no object lookup

REVISION_ABBREVIATION_CLAIM.binding: unverified attribution only, never resolve or use as full Git pointer

SHA256_CLAIM.binding: unverified attribution only, never recomputed raw availability

INERT_HOST_PATH.syntax: absolute / or $PWD/ prefix, followed only by ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, dot, slash, @, plus, hyphen; max1024 bytes

INERT_REPO_PATH_CLAIM.syntax: docs/tests/tools/src/migrations relative prefix, ASCII path characters, no terminal slash, empty/dot/dot-dot component; max1024 bytes
INERT_REPO_PATH_CLAIM.binding: body attribution only, never a lookup pointer

INERT_TEXT_ID.syntax: HG/KL display or compact identity with declared case/spelling, max80
INERT_TEXT_ID.binding: unverified subject attribution; never task exemption or selected role

INERT_UUID_CLAIM.binding: attribution only; no human approval or thread-message authorization

COUNTER_CLAIM.syntax: decimal integer 0..1000000; no sign/exponent/dot/Boolean, max7 bytes
COUNTER_CLAIM.binding: unverified attributed claim; each occurrence independent except an enumerated relation

POSITIVE_COUNT_CLAIM.syntax: decimal integer 1..1000000; no sign/exponent/dot/Boolean, max7 bytes
POSITIVE_COUNT_CLAIM.binding: unverified attributed claim; each occurrence independent except an enumerated relation

PERCENT_CLAIM.binding: unverified attributed claim; each occurrence independent except an enumerated relation

DURATION_CLAIM.syntax: finite nonnegative decimal seconds <=1000000, max32 bytes; no sign/exponent/NaN/inf/Boolean
DURATION_CLAIM.binding: unverified attributed claim; each occurrence independent except an enumerated relation

VERSION_CLAIM.syntax: 2..4 decimal components separated by dots; each <=1000000, max32 bytes
VERSION_CLAIM.binding: unverified attributed claim; each occurrence independent except an enumerated relation

CLOCK_HOURS_CLAIM.binding: unverified attributed claim; each occurrence independent except an enumerated relation

CLOCK_SUBMINUTE_CLAIM.syntax: exact two decimal digits 00..59, max2 bytes
CLOCK_SUBMINUTE_CLAIM.binding: unverified attributed claim; each occurrence independent except an enumerated relation

EXPLICIT_ZERO_EXIT_CLAIM.syntax: exact literal 0, max1 byte; original transcribed claim only, never native parent execution proof
EXPLICIT_ZERO_EXIT_CLAIM.binding: unverified attributed claim; each occurrence independent except an enumerated relation

INERT_ENV_LABEL.syntax: kl_<lowercase alphanumeric component>_<lowercase alphanumeric component> with optional _test; max128 bytes
INERT_ENV_LABEL.binding: unverified environment label only, no namespace reservation/database/Compose lookup or execution

PYTEST_PROGRESS_CLAIM.syntax: one or more ASCII dots, max262144 bytes
PYTEST_PROGRESS_CLAIM.binding: transcribed passing-item progress only; enumerated phase sum/percentage relations required; no native execution proof

INERT_REPO_DIRECTORY_CLAIM.syntax: same finite ASCII relative path components with exactly one required terminal slash, removed once only before component validation; max1024 bytes
INERT_REPO_DIRECTORY_CLAIM.binding: inert original directory attribution only, never a lookup pointer

INERT_IPV4_CLAIM.syntax: four decimal octets 0..255 separated by dots, max15 bytes
INERT_IPV4_CLAIM.binding: inert transcribed host attribution only, never lookup/network/environment authority

INERT_PORT_CLAIM.binding: inert transcribed port only, never network/database/Compose lookup

token_properties: slot has type,binding,max_bytes,alias, optional spelling; unknown properties deny
semantic repeated aliases agree; unrelated numeric coincidences not aliased
original report-ref check shape cardinality/order exact
slot max_bytes is the per-token cap and may not exceed the corresponding vocabulary cap

relations.schema: Each relation has exactly kind plus declared properties; unknown fields/kinds, missing fields, unknown aliases or role/type/array arity mismatch DENY. Alias strings resolve only within the same whole production; arrays are nonempty bounded1024 unique aliases, min2/exact3 where named. Clock sequence is HOURS,SUBMINUTE,SUBMINUTE; progress parts and percentages have equal length. Nullable integer alias permits only null or one integer alias.

meanings.equality: bounded decimal integer numeric-value equality, no float/Boolean alias
meanings.progress_sum: sum dot lengths equals terminal count
meanings.progress_percent: each cumulative dot count times100 integer-floor-divided by positive terminal equals corresponding percent
meanings.collection_total: collected equals passed plus optional deselected
meanings.not_record_T: each separately attributed full revision differs from recordT
meanings.active_not_more_than_tasks: each transcribed active count <= same transcribed total tasks
meanings.decreased_count: explicit earlier active count strictly greater than later count

relations.current_catalog_scope: All33 complete closed productions and all listed present relations; six human dispositions resolved for preparation only; no runtime inference or further unresolved relation permission

numeric_work: Use bounded decimal arithmetic, no float overflow or exponent syntax.
